rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Rust-based SQLite server using the native sqlite3_set_authorizer API for query-preparation-level permission enforcement. Provides 13 tools including SQL execution, schema introspection, full-text search, backups, and database maintenance with five preset permission levels and column-level granularity.
